confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Tampa and US Gulf Coast pricing for July 2026. No live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and bar anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with season and events. Hotel anchors are assumed to be before taxes and resort fees. Cocktail and wine are set from the local price relationship to beer (about 2.1x and 1.8x), since direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6947 USD/AUD observation dated 2026-10-16 came from search snippets of the RBA exchange-rates page and secondary reporting of the RBA table. I did not open the RBA F11.1 CSV directly, so verify the figure against https://www.rba.gov.au/statistics/tables/csv/f11.1-data.csv before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against mid-sized Florida tourism cities such as Orlando, St. Petersburg and Fort Lauderdale, with a general US mid-market restaurant and hotel basis. Accommodation assumes a July shoulder-to-peak summer rate in Florida.
